name: DarknessCon Boise
blurb: Boise-area stop of the touring DarknessCon horror convention, with celebrity and author guests, vendors, cosplay and a late-night Zombie Prom-style party.

editions.evidence: Dedicated event page (darknesscon.com/boise): 'JUNE 18 & 19, 2027 BOISE CANYON COUNTY FAIRGROUNDS' with a live countdown (257 days from the 2026-10-05 check date, consistent with June 2027); page title 'DarknessCon Boise — June 18 & 19, 2027'.

notes: Canyon County Fairgrounds is in Caldwell, ID (confirmed by web search), not Boise proper, matching the seed note that this is a Boise-area edition. The site's own JSON-LD metadata is stale and disagrees with the live page (it says July 9-10, 2027 at 'Expo Idaho'); per the research procedure, the visible page text and countdown timer were trusted instead, since they agree with each other and the JSON-LD does not match the page's own displayed date. A 4th guest card ('To Be Announced / COMING SOON') is a placeholder and was skipped. Multi-city brand (DarknessCon also runs Snake River/Pocatello, Denver, Reno, Salt Lake City and soon Albuquerque/Portland/etc.); this file covers only the Boise edition using its own dedicated page for dates, guests and cover art. Organizer company name not found on the site, left blank.
